reviews.title: Leaving goal after 15 years
reviews.text: I’m not the first to say this, but the ad experience is so horrendous that it pushed me away from the app. I’m fully aware a business needs ad revenue to thrive. I don’t mind goal having ads. But now, every article I open will automatically start playing an ad OUTLOUD on my device without me consenting or having any option to stop this from happening. I put up with poor-quality, typo-riddled writing for years because I’ve just been a loyal goal reader. But them pausing my music every single time I click on an article? For the first time since 2010, I’m now on the hunt for a brand-new football news site. Absolutely shameful

reviews.title: Never write these
reviews.text: Man oh man, I enjoy the app, sometimes we get some decent content, sometimes we don’t. That’s ok. What’s not ok is making sure your ads and videos have volume that supersedes whatever I’m currently playing. If this app shuts my music off one more time, I’m out.

reviews.title: Volume on ads
reviews.text: Been using this app for years and now they have started auto playing the volume on their ads in the background. I’m reading an article why anyone would think I would want to hear the volume of an ad while I’m reading is beyond me. If I want to view the ad and hear the volume I will. Such childish obligation on Goal’s part. Nobody does that on other sites. I will delete this app of that does not change and go back to how it was

reviews.title: Sketchy Spammy Clickbait
reviews.text: I’ve used Goal for years even though I’ve never particularly liked it. The level of journalism is high school/first year uni newspaper, and the app and website are so heavily ad driven that neither is a pleasant experience. The main draw for me has been that Goal has all the social media transfer gossip that respectable news sites don’t always run, and I don’t need to use those social media sites (mostly Twitter and Instagram). Goal started forcing their cookie selection on users awhile back, and I should have uninstalled then. Now they automatically run audiovisual material without giving you the option to automatically mute or just suppress the material. That’s more than a step too far. I’m uninstalling this.

reviews.title: Goal, please fix bugs 🙏
reviews.text:
I use this app daily, but there are currently serious bugs with the app and it’s functionality is at an all time low based on my many years of usage. Please fix and I will return to give better review. I have always appreciated this app but am here to let you know the app is presently in poor shape. 

Currently when I select a specific match, it is either extremely slow or impossible to load the different sections under the match (such as standings, comments, etc). This was never an issue in the past but is a persistent issue now, even with full wifi strength. 

By the way, why is it “standings” now instead of “table?” As an American, I can assure you, no one wants the needless Americanization of football terms.
